steps.arm_next_note: deliberately absent. The plan lint refuses arm_next on the final step, because it would demand a continuation that cannot exist — the run ends here by design, not by forgetting.

rules: A step passes only when its verify_cmd exits 0. Status is never written from prose.

A step does not close until arm_next exits 0 — the continuation must already be running before the turn ends. The absence of this mechanism produced a 6h40m silence on 2026-08-17, after the rule had been written in a document by the person who then broke it.
No verification command truncates its output. The flake lost its test name to a tail -1, which is the same class of error as reading an exit code instead of the message.
Read command OUTPUT, not exit codes alone: flutter install printed 'Install failed' and exited 0 here.
git add takes an explicit file list, never a directory.

A gate whose gap is the FEATURE is recorded as such. Closing a gate by naming an unrelated test after it is the worst available outcome, because it is greppable and wrong — hence the red-green double run in step 4.
A measurement that cannot be taken is recorded as not-measured with its reason, never estimated into a cell that reads measured.
A constant that measured results depend on is versioned, never edited in place.
Eight gates stay open by design. Nine means the goal was not met.
